The '''IW-37 pincer loader''', also known as the '''salvager''', was a durasteel-covered support-droid.

==Characteristics==
[[File:IW-37_pincer_loader_TCWCG.png|left|thumb|An IW-37 holding a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]].]]
The IW-37 used its grasping arm to load cargo or armaments into tight spaces, like the compartment holds in [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptors]].

It had more dexterous manipulators than the [[CLL-M2 binary loadlifter/Legends|CLL-M2 Ordnance lifter]], allowing it to load rockets and torpedoes.

It was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was sometimes used to collect unused munition and salvage weaponry from wrecked enemy ships.
